explanation: Not on erdosproblems.com/1100; checked against [ErTe89] (renyi.hu/~p_erdos/1989-37.pdf), Théorème 4: for x ≥ 3, max_{n≤x} f(n) ≥ exp(((log 2)² + o(1))·log x/(log₂ x)²), where log₂ is the iterated logarithm and f is τ_⊥. The Lean statement: ∀ δ > 0, for all large real x, ∃ n ≤ x with exp(((log 2)² − δ)·log x/(log log x)²) ≤ tauPerp n, the standard unpacking of the o(1). Faithful to the paper.
